philosophy.note: Tiers are Athlete Life OS performance bands, not population percentiles or claims of competitive elite status.
philosophy.confidence: Each domain level is shown separately from data confidence.

sources.title: ACSM Position Stand: Resistance Training Prescription for Muscle Function, Hypertrophy, and Physical Performance in Healthy Adults
sources.use: Strength/power testing context and progressive resistance-training interpretation.

sources.title: Relationship of lat-pull repetitions and pull-ups to maximal lat-pull and pull-up strength
sources.use: Supports loaded pull-up 1RM/relative-load testing as a meaningful upper-body strength measure.

sources.title: Validity and reliability analysis of Cooper's 12-minute run and the multistage shuttle run in healthy adults
sources.use: Field aerobic tests are practical/reliable but have individual prediction error.

sources.title: Cooper's 12 Minute Run Systematically Underestimates VO2max in Collegiate Team Sport Athletes
sources.use: Cooper is treated as screening/performance evidence rather than exact VO2max truth.

sources.title: Assessment of Countermovement Jump: What Should We Report?
sources.use: CMJ performance variables can be reliable when test protocol is standardized.

sources.title: World Athletics Scoring Tables of Athletics
sources.use: Official athletics performance-comparison framework; app does not currently claim WA points unless a table is explicitly encoded.

notes: Strength and running bands are transparent Athlete OS heuristics for within-app classification. They are not medical norms.
Calisthenics classification is movement-difficulty based because robust population normative datasets for advanced static skills are not available.
Competitive/elite status in a sport should be based on formal competition standards, federation rankings or official scoring systems, not this app alone.
